titleFreelance: Every website is a valuable link between you and your users.
introText: I build websites and applications for SMEs in every region of Switzerland. A former professional chef, I bring the same precision as a starred kitchen.
contactCTA: Got a project? Write to me
message: A website is more than just existing online — it's a true bridge to your customers. Through clear, simple, and smooth experiences, I help you build a strong and lasting connection with them.

services.title: Professional & multilingual websites
description: A website that looks like you, easy to read on phone and computer
Built to be found on Google in your area
Once paid, it is all yours: the website, the code and the domain name
Example: the RDF Bachata Fusion dance school, in three languages, with online booking

services.title: Custom applications for your business
description: A tool built around the way you work, not the other way around
You manage content and users yourself, without calling me
Everyone sees only what concerns them: customers, team, administrators
Live example: Zenevents.ch, a Swiss marketplace

services.title: Automation & AI integrations
description: Confirmations and quote requests sent automatically
Your texts translated by AI into your customers' languages
Connected to your tools: Google Maps, EventFrog, WhatsApp, Google Drive
Example: TrustBrain, the AI assistant that answers from your documents alone

sections.title: Attention to detail
content: Trained in fine dining, in starred restaurants and at Alain Ducasse, I check everything before every site goes live.
On Zenevents.ch, each provider has a web address in their own name: given free, unasked.

sections.title: Real listening
content: I am not selling you a ready-made solution. I listen first, and I always ask you what the goal is: why this project?
One client wanted two user journeys: I suggested a single one instead, which is simpler.

sections.title: A human relationship
content: I believe in mutual respect, in trust and in transparency: these are also the things I find interesting in Buddhism.
Your single point of contact: me. And all of my clients are still working with me today.

sections.title: Clear, no jargon
content: No unnecessary technical jargon. I explain each of my choices in plain language, and I check in with you every week.
My quote breaks down every line item, and also states what is not included in the price.

pricing.title: Pricing
notes: Payment in CHF or EUR, in 2 to 6 installments with no fees, depending on the project
A bug caused by my work is fixed free of charge
Hosting and domain name included for the first year, then in your name
Training on how to use your site included

items.question: How much does a website cost?
items.answer: An Essential website starts at CHF 1,990 and a Complete website at CHF 3,900. Custom applications are quoted individually, after a free first conversation. You know exactly what you are paying before we get started.

items.question: Can I pay in installments?
items.answer: Yes, with no fees: in 2 or 3 installments, up to 6 depending on the amount. I start working once the first payment arrives, and the rest follow every month, on the same date. You pay by bank transfer, in CHF or EUR.

items.question: How long until my website is online?
items.answer: A showcase website is online 3 to 4 weeks after the first payment, provided that your content and approvals arrive on time. For a more complex project, the timeline depends on the work: I will tell you at the start.

items.question: How does a project work?
items.answer: A first conversation, no commitment. Then the specifications, the quote and the contract. I start at the first payment, with a check-in every week. You see the site before it goes online, then I train you to use it.

items.question: Do I need technical knowledge?
items.answer: No. I only need to know the goal of your project: I take care of the rest, and I explain it to you in plain language. If you already have a website or a domain name, I take them over when it is technically possible.

items.question: What happens after launch?
items.answer: Once the project is paid for, the website, the code and the domain name are yours. A bug that comes from my work, I fix at no charge. For everything else, you choose: maintenance at CHF 89/month or a price per task.

contact.title: Ready to Start Your Project?
contact.subtitle: Let's discuss your needs together and find the ideal solution for your business.
